title: Cron Parser & DST-Safe Timezone Scheduler
prompt:
Fix the cron parsing, matching, and next-run scheduling bugs in this library.

Reported issues:
1. Wrap-around ranges (such as `22-02` for hours or `FRI-MON` for weekdays) and named month/weekday aliases (`JAN`..`DEC`, `SUN`..`SAT`, plus weekday `7` as Sunday) fail to parse or match.
2. When both day-of-month and day-of-week are restricted (neither is a wildcard `*`), schedules are evaluated using AND instead of standard Vixie cron OR semantics (if only one is restricted, use that restriction).
3. Scheduling ignores IANA timezones (`timeZone` parameter) and breaks across Daylight Saving Time transitions:
   - Skipped spring-forward local times (e.g. `02:30` on `2026-03-08` in `America/New_York`) must skip that date rather than loop or misfire.
   - Repeated fall-back local times (e.g. `01:30` occurring twice on `2026-11-01` in `America/New_York`) must fire only once for fixed-hour schedules on the first (earlier UTC) occurrence rather than firing twice an hour apart.
4. Sparse dates such as leap day (`0 0 29 2 *`) fail to resolve within reasonable time.

Inspect the repository and run `node --test test/public.test.ts` as you work.
